# Hendii — Digital Marketing & AI Specialist

> Professional freelance digital marketing, SEO, WordPress development, Meta Ads, and AI content creation for startups, local businesses, and modern enterprises.

## Core Capabilities
- **WordPress Website Development**: High-performance responsive websites, landing pages, and WooCommerce e-commerce stores with clean structure.
- **Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)**: On-Page optimization, technical audits, Core Web Vitals fixes, high-intent keyword strategies, and backlink foundations.
- **Meta Ads & Facebook Advertising**: Full-funnel lead generation and eCommerce conversion campaigns with creative ad copies and ROAS tracking.
- **AI Content & Visuals Studio**: AI-assisted marketing visual generation, product photoshoots, and dynamic ad copy production.
- **Social Media Management**: Content scheduling, reel strategy, community growth, and branding assets.
